name: The Core of Wallhop Tower
desc:
🌆 The Core of Wallhop Tower 🌆

Climb your way to the top in this skill-based wallhop obby! Test your timing, patience, and parkour skills in a sleek tower built for serious players.

✅ Carry Player
✅ Clean, minimalist style
✅ Great for practicing wallhops

💎 VIP Gamepass 💎
Perks:

• /sc1 and /sc2 to teleport and pick your stage

• ⭐ Special chat tag

• Can do /bring [player] and /to [player]
Thanks for your support!

👍 Like the game if you enjoy it!

Inspired by Wallhop Towers

Developed by leflameL
